summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of senior secured convertible notes. On September 10, 2026, the company issued $11,596,172.68 aggregate principal notes for $4.5 million cash plus exchange of $4,545,014.69 of existing notes, an aggregate purchase price of $9,045,014.69 at a 22% original issue discount. Notes carry 8% interest, mature nine months, default rate 18%, secured by substantially all assets, convertible at the lower of $3.12 or 80% of the 15-day VWAP, subject to a 20% floor and a 19.99% exchange cap pending shareholder approval. This is a routine financing, not a special situation. Watch dilution, default risk, and Nasdaq compliance.
